lines.text: I see the way she touches you like she’s just passing through
Barely even claims you when the night is almost through
She don’t pull you closer, doesn’t take her time
I’m the one who’s ready, reading every sign
You don’t have to hide it, I already know
There’s a hunger in you that she won’t let show
I can love you better than she ever could
Make you feel it deeper, give you what she should
Let me take the wheel, baby, let me pull you in
I can love you better — just let me begin
She’s got the title but she’s half-asleep
I’m wide awake and diving in the deep
I know exactly where to put my hands
I’m ready to begin to work my plan
You don’t have to fight it, I already know
There’s a fire in you that she never stoked
I can love you better than she ever could
Make you feel it deeper, give you what she should
Let me take the wheel, baby, let me pull you in
I can love you better — just let me begin
I’m not here to play nice, I’m not here to wait
I’m the open door while she’s locking the gate
One night is all it takes to cross that line
Once you feel this body, you won’t leave it behind
I can love you better than she ever could
Make you feel it deeper, give you what she should
Let me take the wheel, baby, let me pull you in
I can love you better — just let me begin
